ratings.name: Hevy
limitations: Light theme only; OS unknown with iOS-style status icons
Green rows extend outside the phone frame (promotional composite)
No keyboard, running timer, or history-detail state shown
adopt: Previous load x reps column directly beside current kg/reps
Actual-load chart metric (heaviest weight) rather than derived scores
avoid: Explore/social and volume header stats
Accent fill on completed rows and exercise titles
PR badges and one-rep-max selector

ratings.name: Strong
limitations: Lower numpad/plate region is composite, not proof of keyboard behaviour
Progress chart is estimated 1RM, not actual per-set history
No routine-selection or history screen retained
adopt: Identical colour-role mapping across dark and light themes
Focused field outlined with caret; pending fields as neutral pills; grey vs filled check
Remaining-time bar attached to the set it follows
avoid: Est. 1RM chart and profile dashboard
Stacked note boxes above the set table
Pale green completed rows in light theme (low distinction)

ratings.name: Fitbod
limitations: Dark theme only; homepage returned 403 so only Play media reviewed
History is a chip, not an open view; no previous-values column shown
Completion tap target (hexagon check) not evidenced as interactive
adopt: Done / next / later emphasis ladder with one bright-outlined active row
Compact exercise list rows with sets/reps/load summary
avoid: Strength scores and AI plan generation
Photography hero consuming set-entry space
Italic display numerals for data

ratings.name: Boostcamp
limitations: Dark theme only; OS unknown with iOS-style status icons
Toolbar 12:06 not proven to be a rest countdown
RPE grid shown, but optional-RIR entry flow not evidenced; placeholder Latin notes
adopt: Numbered exercises with per-exercise rest icon
Two-line previous cell carrying an effort annotation (e.g. 2 RIR)
avoid: RPE grid, Calc tool and % of 1RM targets
Accent colour on exercise titles as well as Finish and checks
Tiny RPE badge inside the input corner

ratings.name: Alpha Progression
limitations: Dark theme only; iPhone-style frame on an Android listing
Yesterday table is depicted, not tested comparability logic
Editability of pill values and wrench/pencil headers not evidenced
adopt: Compact prior-session mini-table aligned to the entry columns
Plan day tabs with 'Day 2 · 6 exercises · 19 sets' summary
avoid: 10RM derived column and autopilot progression
Wrench/pencil glyph on every header
Exercise thumbnail strip

ratings.name: Liftin'
limitations: iOS reference only; not an Android implementation reference
Illustrated finger obscures set 3; timer and Add + are enlarged callouts of unknown in-app position
'One tap' is advertising copy; logging interaction not evidenced
adopt: Rest readout showing remaining and total together (0:30 / 1:30)
Large plain numerals in list rows
avoid: Weight PR cards and calendar as motivation
Per-side plate diagrams
iOS chrome and pink brand treatment

ratings.name: Rebuild 0.1.3 baseline
limitations: Emulator captures, not Galaxy A71 or TalkBack evidence
Keyboard closed in all captures; portrait only; synthetic two-workout history
Theming score aggregates dark (approx. 3) and light (approx. 2) in one row
adopt: Keep filled Log set, labelled outlined fields, warm-up checkbox, exercise chips with counts, persistent rest bar
Keep honest helper copy and editable history with pencil icons
avoid: Amber text buttons for every secondary link
Prose 'Last comparable' sentence instead of an aligned prior-set row
Flat, ungrouped surfaces; light theme brown slab primary on beige

rebuild_dark: Preserve. The #171410 / #E6C27A palette, rounded-outline icons, bottom navigation and screen order are coherent and should not change. Improve only by adding one level of surface grouping (entry card, logged-set rows, prior-set mini-table) and by restricting amber to Log set, Finish and the current chip so the accent regains meaning.
rebuild_light: Change without removing. Reduce beige chroma toward a near-white warm neutral, render the primary action as a tonal amber container with dark text so it matches the dark theme's object identity (role parity as in R2), and use a darker, less muddy brown only for the few remaining text links. Verify every text-on-container pair for contrast before shipping.
top_changes: Light theme token retune: tonal amber primary button, lower-chroma surfaces, darker link colour; check contrast pairs and paired captures
Replace the prose 'Last comparable' line with a 2-3 row prior-set mini-table aligned to kg/reps/RIR; check 200% wrapping, TalkBack order, landscape
Accent discipline: demote Next/Target details/Change phase/Alerts links to onSurfaceVariant text or outlined chips; keep 48 dp targets and existing labels
Surface grouping and logged-set rows with a tertiary done indicator in both themes; check IME insets and rest-bar visibility
Rest bar shows remaining / total with tabular digits; check 200% overflow and timer persistence
uncertainties: R2 theming could reasonably be 3 given the washed light-green rows
R3 hierarchy could be 4 if the hero media is discounted as promotional framing
Splitting RB theming into dark 3 / light 2 is an equally valid presentation
Whether an aligned prior-set table beats a sentence for a two-set program is a judgment, not a measurement
All reference scores describe publisher artwork; no interaction, contrast, target size or dynamic text was verified
